answer: In this PoA design, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted trust edge, while EigenTrust factorization and transitive support determine node centrality. Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so honest influence requires sustained service rather than a brief gale, voyage, or comet-like burst. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted backing, and cannot cross the consensus threshold or amplify its identities.
